direction: Vectors animate only on solid editorial cards or solid areas separate from imagery. No vectors overlay photos or generated video. Supersedes vector-placement/composition.json.
scope: Figma design only. No Remotion animation or video generation performed.

notes.last: An ivory editorial card pairs 20+ years with the mountain illustration. No image sits behind the artwork.
notes.motion: Establish the landscape, cut to ivory, then reveal the number and draw the mountain contours.
notes.art: 112 px headline / 34 px support. Emerald and gold vectors on a solid ivory field.

notes.last: Research copy at left; generated milk-and-whey sampling fills the upper-right window, with the flask illustration on ivory below.

notes.last: An oversized 2016 and a flag timeline share a clean ivory editorial card.

notes.last: The year and capacity stay at left; production footage occupies the upper-right window, with processing vessels on green below.

notes.art: 132 px year / 64 px capacity. Ivory and gold illustration stays clear of the footage.

notes.art: Keep the image unobstructed. Emerald and gold artwork belongs entirely below the image window.

notes.last: A solid emerald card pairs the large 75–98% statement with a conceptual protein-process illustration.
notes.motion: Leave the concept image before revealing the statistic. Draw the processing gate and nodes on the clean green card.

notes.art: 196 px number / 40 px descriptor. Exactly twenty blocks; the grid represents a count, not a chemical sequence.

notes.last: One approved product cutout sits at right; six growth petals accompany the large count on the clear ivory field at left.
notes.motion: Reveal the jar and number, then open six petals beside the count. Keep the graphic separate from the product.
notes.art: Preserve the approved jar; six petals express variety without inventing additional packages.

notes.last: Filling footage occupies the upper-right window. The quality illustration sits on ivory below; standards remain text at left.

notes.art: Keep checks out of the footage. They illustrate inspection steps, not certification badges.

notes.last: A grazing yak fills the upper strip. The organic statement and leaf illustration sit in a separate ivory band below.
notes.motion: Resolve the footage into the upper strip, reveal the statement, and grow the leaf only inside the ivory band.
notes.art: 54 px headline / 32 px support. No vector over the yak image and no invented organic seal.

notes.last: The approved jar is large and unobstructed at right, with 80% and its descriptor on a clean green field at left.
notes.motion: Let the product settle; reveal the statistic, descriptor and event line in readable beats. No decorative vector overlay.
notes.art: 132 px statistic / 38 px support. Keep the product clear; the podium illustration stays in the asset library.

notes.last: The family image stays above a spacious ivory title band, with the cup illustration beside the supporting copy.
notes.motion: Let the breakfast moment breathe, then reveal the ivory band. Animate the cup and drop entirely inside that band.
notes.art: 52 px headline / 32 px support. Keep this approved composition; no graphics over the people.

notes.last: A clean green editorial card pairs collaboration copy with a small researcher-and-notebook illustration at right.

notes.art: Keep the illustration on solid green. No logos, endorsements or invented clinical results.
